question: What percentage of the total minimum capital lease payments due from Union Pacific Corporation as of December 31, 2018, are scheduled to be paid in 2021?
retrieval_query: Union Pacific Corporation minimum capital lease payments December 31 2018 2021 percentage
answer:
2021 payment: $303 million  
Total minimum capital lease payments: $2,646 million  

Percentage scheduled to be paid in 2021:  
(303 / 2646) × 100 ≈ 11.45%

Source: finqa_test_ctx_125.pdf p.1
